metadata.method: Serial predict including tokenization, copies, inference and formatting. No HTTP. First use and model load excluded. Exclusive GPU/build lock.
metadata.validation_scope: Synthetic implementation parity, not labeled model quality.

validation_scope: All 66 requests, stopping on a numerical rejection or time budget. Checkpoints retain the tested subset.

action_analysis.method: For each two-class action output, maximum absolute per-logit error e changes the logit difference by at most 2e. A positive lower bound preserves argmax. A margin exceeding 20 ensures both probabilities round to the same saturated values at four decimal places. This is only a bound for these synthetic requests, not a guarantee for new data.
